title: Planets that carry their own physics

cases.says: Each planet computes its surface gravity and a surface weight from its own mass and radius, and the queries over planets use them.
strongest() compares surface gravity: among Uranus, Saturn and Neptune it is Neptune, though Saturn is heavier and larger.
withGravityBetween() includes a planet whose gravity equals a bound.
withGravityBetween() lists planets in declaration order, not sorted by gravity.
strongest() of an empty collection throws NoSuchElementException, not null or another exception.

origin.section: Q2: Explain the Planet enum pattern and its advantages over plain constants.
